rules.statement: A tenant who has paid rent in advance and is subsequently in arrears can have that advanced rent applied against the arrears without a specific request from the tenant.
rules.supporting_quote: "Thus the excess rent of Rs. 1866/24 and the three months' advance rent of Rs. 600 aggregating Rs. 2,466.24 will have to be credited to the defendant in the process of ascertaining from what date he was in arrears."
